label: Authentication decision
content: The system uses short-lived signed session tokens and rotates refresh tokens on every use.

label: Audit integrity
content: Every epigenetic event stores the previous event hash and its own SHA-256 hash so tampering is detectable.

label: Explicit feedback rule
content: Only explicit accepted or rejected feedback changes retrieval utility; silence never changes memory.

label: Token reduction gate
content: The primary gate requires at least twenty-five percent fewer context tokens than the strongest baseline.

label: Quality non-inferiority gate
content: Key-fact coverage may be no more than two percentage points below the strongest baseline.

label: Citation gate
content: At least ninety-five percent of selected evidence must have a valid source citation.
